free-chicken-alfredo is LIVE (plan-2026-09-22-6 item discovered:free-chicken-alfredo-live-2026-09-21 status done, 'published by the integrator') but C:\Codex\ThriftyCrew\meal-prep\db\built\free-chicken-alfredo.body.html does not exist; the card exists only in worktrees agent-ac5f626bdaf27c684 and agent-acc4db640d784b57b
feed-everyday-ps.ps1 line 96 (before): a slug is filled only when Join-Path $BuiltDir ($s + '.body.html') exists, so a card built elsewhere fails closed for good

after the fix, run over a copy of that same feed: 'feed-everyday-ps: 4 card(s) built here for recipes with no card ... free-chicken-alfredo,shredded-bbq-chicken-sammies,chicken-marinara-pasta,beef-protein-pasta; 0 could not be built', 'everyday_ps for 570 of 570 recipes', free-chicken-alfredo everyday_ps 2.00 (the live card read ~$2.00 on 2026-09-23)

surface_fix.what: the next daily export writes everyday_ps for free-chicken-alfredo, so prepare-article-price-edits -Land stops refusing welcome
surface_fix.exact_change: Resolve-TcEverydayCards: a feed slug with no card in BuiltDir and a spec in db\recipes is built by build-card2 into a per-run scratch directory and handed to the harness

items.root_cause: db/built is gitignored, so a recipe built and published from a worktree leaves no card in the chain's checkout, and the only writer of the feed's everyday_ps reads cards from that checkout alone: every span on another page naming such a recipe keeps its stamped fallback forever, and nothing pages

root_fix.what: feed-everyday-ps builds a missing card from its tracked spec with the card's own builder instead of requiring a card this checkout never received
root_fix.exact_change: new function Resolve-TcEverydayCards (builder seam $Build); the live path passes build-card2 -SpecFile -CostedFile db\costed.json -OutDir <scratch>, prints how many it built and which could not be built, removes the scratch in finally

blast_radius.measured_by: no matching rule changed; measured as feed recipes gaining everyday_ps over a copy of the served feed of 2026-09-25T08:15:36
blast_radius.risk: the 566 recipes with a card keep that card and are never rebuilt (CLEAN TWIN); a build that throws or writes no body leaves the recipe without the key, as before

proof.must_fire_case: MUST FIRE  a recipe with a spec and NO built card here (free-chicken-alfredo, built in a worktree) is built into scratch and filled
proof.clean_twin: CLEAN TWIN  a recipe whose card IS built here uses that card and is never rebuilt; MUST NOT FIRE a build that throws, a build with no body and a recipe with no spec get no card
commands: feed-everyday-ps.ps1 -FeedPath <copy of the served feed> -PublicPath <scratch> (exit 0, 570 of 570)
